node.name: UDP_Network
node.rich_text:
Protocol - transport-layer protocol defined in RFC 768 - Connectionless - Unreliable
|- handshake |- guarantee of delivery NO-----| |- order |- duplicate protection
UDP header is 8 bytes --> fixed size (TCP is 20 so it is slower than UDP) (some more reasons: - smaller header - no handshake - no acks)
FEATURE UDP TCP ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Connection-----Connectionless-----Connection Oriented 2. Reliability-----------Unreliable------------------Reliable 3. Ordering--------Not Guaranteed------------Guaranteed 4. Speed-------------------Faster------------Comparitively Slower 5. Header Size---------8 Bytes----------------------20 Bytes 6. Use case----------Streaming, DNS-----File Transfer, web(HTTPS) VoIP, Gaming email
When UDP is prefered over TCP? --> Speed matters more than quality. --> Small, Simple queries (DNS) --> Broadcast/Multicast applications --> Application that has its own reliability layer
Server: socket() -> creates UDP socket bind() -> attaches IP + Port recvfrom() -> wait for client message sendto() -> reply close()
Client: socket() -> Creates UDP socket sendto() -> sends message to server (no Connect() needed) recvfrom() -> gets response close()
